marketing spend sell-out share smart switch

steps.say: MA has no NERP spend posted for 2026-Q3, so it cannot be ranked. Calculating the proxy for EG, SA and AE.

args.title: Investment-efficiency proxy, 2026-Q3
args.subtitle: Extra sell-out units (Q3 vs Q2) per USD 1M of Q3 marketing spend. Not ROI. MA not ranked: no Q3 spend.
args.note: Proxy = (Q3 sell-out - Q2 sell-out) / Q3 spend in USD millions (NERP planning FX).

steps.answer:
**EG ranks first on an investment-efficiency proxy for 2026-Q3, ahead of SA and AE. MA cannot be ranked because no Q3 spend is posted in NERP.** This is a proxy, not proven ROI: the sources have spend and outcomes but no incrementality, margin or counterfactual. All figures are SYNTHETIC test data.

[{chart}]

| Rank | Market | Q3 spend | Sell-out Q2 → Q3 | Proxy (extra units per USD 1M) | Share gain | Observed Apple + Xiaomi switchers (Q3) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | EG | $1.5M [{spend}] | 240,000 → 262,000 [{sellout}] | 14,667 | +1.6 pp [{share}] | 7,300 [{switching}] |
| 2 | SA | $4.2M [{spend}] | 410,000 → 452,000 [{sellout}] | 10,000 | +0.8 pp [{share}] | 18,400 [{switching}] |
| 3 | AE | $2.6M [{spend}] | 180,000 → 205,000 [{sellout}] | 9,615 | −0.3 pp [{share}] | 11,900 [{switching}] |
| — | MA | not posted [{spend}] | 95,000 → 101,000 [{sellout}] | not ranked | +0.4 pp [{share}] | 2,100 [{switching}] |

**How the proxy works:** (Q3 sell-out − Q2 sell-out) ÷ Q3 marketing spend in USD millions, using NERP planning-rate USD. Share gain is Samsung volume share in percentage points; switching counts are observed Smart Switch transfers from Apple and Xiaomi, shown separately rather than blended into one score.

**What qualifies the ranking**
- **Signals disagree in AE:** sell-out grew 13.9% but Samsung share fell 0.3 pp, so the market grew faster than Samsung did.
- **Switching coverage differs:** only 48% of new EG devices are observed by Smart Switch, against 62% in SA and 71% in AE [{coverage}]. EG's lower switcher count partly reflects lower observation.
- **Scale matters:** SA added the most units (+42,000) and the most observed switchers, at a higher spend.
- **Not causal:** the Z Flip8/Fold8 launch and seasonality lift Q3 sell-out regardless of spend, and spend effects can lag.
- **Draft definition:** the proxy definition has not been signed by the CFO or marketing owner.

**Useful next questions**
- Show EG and SA Q3 spend by category and campaign objective.
- Compare the same proxy for 2026-Q2 to see whether EG's lead is stable.
